# xSimpleVPN for macOS 1.1.1 (10)
This preview adds a native VIP subscription flow for the direct-download Mac app.
- Subscribe for USD $2.99 per month through Stripe-hosted Checkout. - Open Stripe's hosted customer portal to manage payment details or cancel renewal. - Activate VIP only after a signed Stripe webhook confirms a settled payment. - Revoke only Stripe-derived access after a full refund or unresolved dispute. - Keep Apple and permanent administrator VIP grants separate from Stripe billing. - Show support codes instead of exposing internal error details. - Check for signed updates automatically and install them without downloading a new DMG. - Provide a manual Check for Updates command in the application menu.
The app is signed with XM LLC's Developer ID and notarized by Apple. The DMG is Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs and requires macOS 13 or later.
Connection testing is still in progress, so this remains a preview release and is not recommended for critical connectivity.
